findings.explanation: Installed skills that were neither loaded nor used through their files in the period. Their name and description are in the context of every request anyway.
findings.action: Remove the skill from the global folder or install it only in the projects that use it. If the client supports it, mark a skill that should only run on request as not automatically invoked in its front matter.
notes: Description sizes are estimates (characters / 4); `--exact` counts them with the Anthropic API.
A skill that is only needed now and then, or by a tool outside the sessions that were read, can still be worth keeping.

findings.explanation: Skills that were loaded in the period but are not installed now: renamed, removed, or built into the client or a plugin. References to them can be cleaned up.
findings.action: Check instruction files and prompts that still refer to the skill.
notes: Skills built into the client or supplied by a plugin are not in the folders AgentLens inventories and show up here too.
